cases.sentence: Так говорит Господь. Небеса — престол мой, и земля — подножие ног моих. Какой вы можете построить мне _____?
cases.translation: What kind of house will you build for me?
cases.explain: The verb 'построить' (to build) requires the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Вот кем я дорожу, тем, кто кроток и сокрушен ________, и трепещет перед словом моим.
cases.translation: I value those who are humble and contrite in spirit and who tremble at my word.
cases.explain: The word 'сокрушен' (contrite) takes the instrumental case to indicate the state or condition.

cases.sentence: Он, режущий в жертву быка, как убивающий _____. Приносящий в жертву ягненка, как ломающий шею псу.
cases.translation: He who kills an ox is as he who kills a man; he who sacrifices a lamb, as he who breaks a dog's neck.
cases.explain: The verb 'убивающий' (killing) takes the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Режущий в жертву быка, как убивающий человека. Приносящий в жертву ягненка, как ломающий шею _____.
cases.translation: He who sacrifices a lamb, as he who breaks a dog's neck.
cases.explain: The verb 'ломающий' (breaking) takes the accusative case for its direct object, and for animate nouns this matches the genitive form.

cases.sentence: Что ж, и я изберу суровое наказание для них, и наведу на них то, чего они боятся. Когда я звал, никто не ответил. Когда я говорил, никто не слушал. Они делали злое в моих глазах и избрали неугодное мне. Слушайте ______ Господне.
cases.translation: Hear the word of the Lord.
cases.explain: The verb 'слушайте' (hear/listen to) requires the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Они сами избрали свои ______, и мерзости их им приятны.
cases.translation: They have chosen their own ways, and their soul delights in their abominations.
cases.explain: The verb 'избрали' (chose) requires the accusative case for the direct object.

cases.sentence: Вот Господь придет в ______, колесницы его подобны урагану, в ярости он обрушит свой гнев.
cases.translation: Behold, Yahweh will come with fire, and his chariots will be like the whirlwind.
cases.explain: The preposition 'в' (in) when indicating presence or state requires the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Огнем и своим _______ Господь исполнит приговор над всеми людьми.
cases.translation: By fire and by his sword Yahweh will execute judgment on all flesh.
cases.explain: The preposition 'своим' (with his) indicates instrumentality, which requires the instrumental case.

reading.ru: Так говорит Господь. Небеса — престол мой, и земля — подножие ног моих.
reading.question: According to this verse, what are the heavens and earth to God?
options: Heaven is his throne and earth is his footstool
Heaven is his dwelling and earth is his kingdom
Heaven is his fortress and earth is his treasure
Heaven is his temple and earth is his altar
reading.correct: Heaven is his throne and earth is his footstool
reading.explain: The verse states 'Небеса — престол мой, и земля — подножие ног моих' — The heavens are my throne and the earth is my footstool.

reading.ru: Вот кем я дорожу, тем, кто кроток и сокрушен духом, и трепещет перед словом моим.
reading.question: Who does God value and cherish?
options: Those who are humble and contrite in spirit and who tremble at his word
Those who are wealthy and powerful in their nations
Those who build great temples and offer many sacrifices
Those who are strong and fearless in battle
reading.correct: Those who are humble and contrite in spirit and who tremble at his word
reading.explain: The text says God values 'тем, кто кроток и сокрушен духом, и трепещет перед словом моим' — those who are humble and contrite in spirit and tremble at his word.

reading.ru: Когда я звал, никто не ответил. Когда я говорил, никто не слушал. Они делали злое в моих глазах и избрали неугодное мне.
reading.question: How did the people respond when God called and spoke to them?
options: They didn't answer when he called and didn't listen when he spoke; they did what was evil in his eyes
They immediately obeyed all his commands
They gathered to hear his words with great reverence
They built temples and offered him many sacrifices
reading.correct: They didn't answer when he called and didn't listen when he spoke; they did what was evil in his eyes
reading.explain: The passage states 'Когда я звал, никто не ответил. Когда я говорил, никто не слушал. Они делали злое в моих глазах' — when I called, no one answered; when I spoke, no one listened; they did evil in my eyes.

reading.ru: Как одна, которую утешает мать, так утешу вас я. Вы будете утешены в Иерусалиме.
reading.question: How will God comfort his people?
options: As a mother comforts her child, so God will comfort them; they will be comforted in Jerusalem
God will give them riches and power
God will protect them from all enemies forever
God will make them the rulers of all nations
reading.correct: As a mother comforts her child, so God will comfort them; they will be comforted in Jerusalem
reading.explain: The text uses the metaphor 'Как одна, которую утешает мать, так утешу вас я' — As one whom his mother comforts, so I will comfort you.

reading.ru: Вот Господь придет в огне, колесницы его подобны урагану, в ярости он обрушит свой гнев и в пылающем пламени свой укор.
reading.question: How will the Lord come to execute judgment?
options: In fire, like a whirlwind, with fierce anger and burning flames of rebuke
In peace and gentleness to all people
With an army of angels singing praises
To rebuild the temple and restore worship
reading.correct: In fire, like a whirlwind, with fierce anger and burning flames of rebuke
reading.explain: The verse describes 'Господь придет в огне, колесницы его подобны урагану, в ярости он обрушит свой гнев' — the Lord will come in fire, his chariots like a whirlwind, with fierce anger.

reading.ru: Они выйдут и посмотрят на трупы тех, кто отступил от меня. Их червь не умрет, и огонь их не угаснет, и они будут внушать отвращение всем людям.
reading.question: What will be the fate of those who turn away from God?
options: They will see the corpses of those who rebelled, whose worm will not die and whose fire will not be quenched
They will be welcomed into heaven with rejoicing
They will receive great rewards and blessings
They will live in peace and prosperity forever
reading.correct: They will see the corpses of those who rebelled, whose worm will not die and whose fire will not be quenched
reading.explain: The text describes the fate: 'Их червь не умрет, и огонь их не угаснет' — their worm will not die and their fire will not be quenched.
